repos_data.description: Free open source crypto trading bot to automate AI, Grid, DCA and TradingView strategies on Binance, Hyperliquid and 15+ exchanges, with a simple interface.

Self-tuning multi-agent AI trading system. 8-source signal fusion (Polymarket + Kalshi + 10 ML models incl. Kronos foundation model), Bull/Bear/Judge debate on Claude Opus 4.7, Portfolio Manager gate.
AI crypto trading bot with deep neural network (84.9% accuracy, 25 coins). BiLSTM + Attention trained on GPU. Bybit, Binance, OKX, Gate.io. Free cloud or self-hosted.

The most comprehensive MCP server for Polymarket — 48 tools spanning direct trading, market discovery, smart money tracking, copy trading, backtesting, risk management, and portfolio optimization. Works with Claude Code, Cursor, or any MCP-compatible client.
